text: Alaa ɓurɗo tooñude haa hewta on dammbuɗo e Allah, ko yahdaani e Makko, wano waɗangol Mo kafidiiɗo, maa genndo maa ɓiɗɗo. Alaa kadi ɓurɗo tooñde wa on fennuɗo wahyu on mo Nulaaɗo Allah on (yo o his) addi. E wonaa ka Yiite woni jaaƴorde yeddude Allah ɓen, ɓe yeddi ko Nulaaɗo Makko on addi kon? Pellet, ko non woniri, weerde maɓɓe, ko nder ton.
